featured_reviews.name: Ashwani kumar Dubey
featured_reviews.review_text:
यह श्री इच्छापूर्ति संकटमोचन महादेव संकटमोचन एक दिव्य एवम जागृत स्थान है।

यहां से जुड़े सभी भक्तो की यथोचित कामना पूरी होती है इसलिए यहां भक्तो को संख्या बढ़ती आई है।

यहां विगत कई वर्षों से श्री राम चरित मानस अखंड रामायण पाठ एवम माता की चौकी
तथा श्री कृष्ण जन्माष्टमी का आयोजन मंदिर के स्थापना के वर्षो से चला आ रहा है।

और प्रत्येक शनिवार श्री राम चरित मानस सुंदरकांड का पाठ सभी भक्तो द्वारा सामूहिक रूप से होता आया है।

महाशिवरात्रि के पावन पर्व पर रुद्राभिषेक एवम हवन दिव्यतम रूप से होता है।

हर साल सभी भक्तो द्वारा एवम मंदिर से जुड़े सभी कार्यकर्ताओं द्वारा महाभंडारा भोजन प्रसाद वितरण का आयोजन प्रत्येक वर्ष होता है।

दरिद्र नारायण की सेवा में सर्दी के मौसम में कंबल वितरण

गरीब कन्याओं को शादी तथा मेडिकल सहायता हेतु सहायता

सभी कार्यकर्ता तथा मंदिर से जुड़े भक्त
अपना यथोचित सामर्थ के अनुसार योगदान देते आए है।

यहां से जुड़कर मैं अपने आपको सौभाग्य शाली समझता हू ।

जय श्री राम
हर हर महादेव।
जय माता दी।
featured_reviews.review_translated_text:
This Shri Ichchhapurti Sankatmochan Mahadev Sankatmochan is a divine and awakened place.

The desires of all devotees associated with this place are fulfilled, and therefore, the number of devotees has been increasing here.

For the past several years, the continuous recitation of Shri Ram Charit Manas, the Akhand Ramayana, and Mata Ki Chowki, and the celebration of Shri Krishna Janmashtami have been held here since the temple's inception.

And every Saturday, the recitation of Shri Ram Charit Manas, the Sunderkand, has been performed collectively by all devotees.

On the auspicious occasion of Mahashivratri, Rudrabhishek and Havan are performed in a divine manner.

Every year, a Mahabhandara (food distribution) is organized by all devotees and temple workers.

Distribution of blankets during the winter season in the service of the poor.

Assistance to poor girls for marriage and medical assistance.

All workers and devotees associated with the temple have been contributing according to their reasonable capacity.

I consider myself fortunate to be associated with this place.

Jai Shri Ram
Har Har Mahadev.
Jai Mata Di.

featured_reviews.name: Vivek Iyer
featured_reviews.review_text: Wonderful spot to hangout and for mini trekking. The top area, if explored a little by bypassing the fence, has a temple. The view of Powai and the other side is beautiful, but also striking. One side slums, other side high rises. Can also see Chanderi Fort, near Badlapur from top.

featured_reviews.name: Sreejesh S
featured_reviews.review_text: It is moderate hike, there is no proper path, rather the way that has been made for laying pipes which is followed to reach the top. Thhe sunrise and sunset are beautiful with you getting the view of powai and vihar Lake from the top. There is also a quite temple on the other side of the fenced summit.

experience_details.name: Can you share more about these topics?

featured_reviews.name: Sumit Sarkar
featured_reviews.review_text: It's a easy trail inside IIT Bombay. Some parts are very sandy, so be careful to slide down. After reaching the top, you will get a mesmerising view of entire IIT, Powai lake, Vihar lake and the adjacent hills.

featured_reviews.name: Arpan Dutta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Sameer hill is located within IIT Bombay campus, although the trek is very small about 20-30 mins will take one to the top of hills, the view and wind at top will surely be a treat. The top of the hillock has a boundary marking the end of campus.
Good escape for students during weekends or for that matter any day of week.
Always remember safety first, won't recommend going there at night.

featured_reviews.name: Anurag Virendra
featured_reviews.review_text: Just went for a trek few days back and it was marvelous view from top. Mind it, that trek road does not exactly show on map. The one it shows is very slippery. So we took inside path near pipes and went up from there. I fell once  but it was okay. View was awesome, one side you see in lakes and iitb and good buildings.। Other side is slum and smaller building. Harsh reality. Just from one place can be differentiated. I will suggest go on a dry day to avoid slippery roads and wear good shoes.

featured_reviews.name: Brijesh
featured_reviews.review_text:
A normal hangout place for students of IIT bombay,
Can have a quality morning and evening walk.
Awesome view of IIT Bombay with both Powai lake and Vihar lake.

featured_reviews.name: Sangram Kadam
featured_reviews.review_text: Awesome place for hiking inside IIT Bombay campus. It will take not more than one hour for climbing. You get good view of campus and the city from above. You also get a glimpse of Vihar lake. It is a must visit place with your friends.

featured_reviews.name: Rituraj Ghosh
featured_reviews.review_text: Aweome place for IITBians for their first weekends in the campus. Its the first place one should go after moving to the campus. The sunset view is fabulous and a small hike with ur buddies is an add-on.
